meta.title: Woori Aroma | Private Spa in Jeju
meta.description: Book a private spa experience in Jungmun, Jeju — just for you and your group. Up to 4 guests, one group at a time.

landing.heroLine1: A private spa experience in Jeju,
landing.heroLine2: exclusively for you and your group.
landing.treatmentsSubheading: Every treatment is private — your group is the only one in the spa.

aromaOil.description: A relaxing full-body massage using aromatherapy oils, ideal for relieving stress and travel fatigue.

hotStone.description: A soothing treatment that combines warm stones with aromatherapy massage for deep relaxation.
hotStone.tagline: Best for deep warmth and tired muscles.

thaiMassage.description: A traditional massage using pressure-point techniques and stretching, for guests who want a firmer, more active treatment.

quickSpaFoot.description: A focused foot and leg treatment for tired feet after walking, sightseeing, or traveling.

facial.description: A refreshing facial care treatment focused on cleansing, moisturizing, and gentle facial relaxation.

thaiMassage.name: Traditional Thai Massage

hotStone.name: Hot Stone Massage
hotStone.description: Warm basalt stones melt away deep muscle tension.

quickSpaFoot.name: Quick Spa – Foot Massage
quickSpaFoot.description: A focused foot and lower-leg massage to ease tired feet in a short session.

facial.name: Skin Care – Facial Spa
facial.description: A gentle cleanse and hydration treatment for glowing skin.
